description: This source file defines the class `PipelineElementResolved`, which is an implementation of the `PipelineElement` interface, representing a pipeline element that contains a resolved value within a processing pipeline.

classes.name: PipelineElementResolved
classes.description: A final class implementing `PipelineElement`, representing a pipeline element with a resolved value. It provides mechanisms for processing and visitor pattern implementations.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new `PipelineElementResolved` instance with the given value.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of pipeline element, which is `RESOLVED`.

methods.name: onResolved
methods.description: Applies the given function to the stored value, returning a new `PipelineElement`.

methods.name: onUnresolved
methods.description: Returns `this` object, since it represents a resolved element.

methods.name: onDeleted
methods.description: Returns `this`, indicating that the element's state doesn't change when deletion occurs.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a visitor implementing `PipelineElementVisitor`, invoking the `resolved` method with the stored value.

methods.name: iterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the singleton list containing the value.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on the stored value.
